_comment: Permissions for working in this repo. It is a markdown knowledge base, so file
reads and edits are broadly allowed. Bash is scoped to the commands this repo
actually uses (git, the validators and generators under .github/scripts, and
read-only shell tools) rather than a blanket wildcard.
Entries referencing absolute paths on a previous machine were removed; they were
already dead, since a wildcard Bash rule subsumed every narrower one.
